competitors.name: Splitwise
competitors.positioning: Splitwise is a popular expense‑splitting app for groups, trips and households.
competitors.reason: The incumbent named in the run input.

competitors.name: Tricount
competitors.positioning: Tricount is a simple free bill‑splitting app that lets groups track expenses and settle up.
competitors.reason: Offers bill splitting with no daily limits and is listed as a Splitwise alternative for India.

competitors.name: Splid
competitors.positioning: Splid is a group expense manager focused on easy entry and settlement.
competitors.reason: Featured as a Splitwise alternative in Indian‑focused guides.

competitors.name: Kittysplit
competitors.positioning: Kittysplit is a lightweight expense‑splitting app for casual groups.
competitors.reason: Listed among top Splitwise alternatives for India.

competitors.name: Settle Up
competitors.positioning: Settle Up is a multi‑currency expense‑splitting app with UPI support.
competitors.reason: Frequently cited as a strong Splitwise competitor with no daily caps and Indian‑relevant features.

competitors.name: SplitFast
competitors.positioning: SplitFast is a Telegram‑native bot that splits expenses directly in chat.
competitors.reason: Promoted as a no‑limit Splitwise alternative, especially for chat‑based groups.

competitors.name: Splitser
competitors.positioning: Splitser is a free group expense management app with web and mobile versions.
competitors.reason: Marketed as a free alternative after Splitwise introduced daily limits.

competitors.name: Cino
competitors.positioning: Cino splits bills automatically using shared virtual cards linked to users’ bank cards.
competitors.reason: Presented as a novel Splitwise alternative that removes manual settlement steps.

competitors.name: FairShare
competitors.positioning: FairShare is an Indian bill‑splitting app with native UPI deep‑linking and free AI receipt scanning.
competitors.reason: Specifically highlighted for India with unlimited transactions and UPI settlement.
